entities.name: Pyotr Pokryshev
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pyotr Afanasyevich Pokryshev was a fighter pilot and squadron commander in the Soviet Airforce during the Second World War who became a flying ace with 18 individual and 9 shared confirmed shootdowns who was twice awarded with the title Hero of the Soviet Union.
